about_the_game:
Rogue Diner is a fast-paced roguelike cooking game where chaos is your main ingredient.

Build and run your own diner, choose your chef, prepare bizarre dishes, and survive wave after wave of increasingly demanding guests. Every run offers new recipes, modifiers, and challenges – making each shift feel fresh, unpredictable, and deliciously stressful.

Up to four players build and operate a diner together. Choose your menu, buy furniture, design your layout for maximum efficiency, and serve your guests before they lose their patience.

Prepare for an unpredictable culinary adventure where quick thinking, adaptation, and teamwork are the key to success.

Manage

Choose your recipes each run – from simple salads to pasta… or even a pasta-burger?!

Plan your kitchen layout and upgrade your diner between shifts to optimize flow and survival.

Cook

Chop, fry, bake and plate a wide variety of dishes – alone or with your team.

Handle shifting modifiers impacting your recipes or creating unexpected cooking hazards.

Serve

Take orders, deliver dishes, and keep your guests satisfied before they storm out.

Face chaotic conditions like fog, fire, or overly impatient customers.

Key Features

  • Roguelike Cooking Gameplay: Each run is a unique culinary survival challenge with different recipes, modifiers, and events.

  • Multiplayer Co-Op: Work together with up to 3 friends to survive the chaos – or go solo if you dare.

  • Unique Characters: Choose from different chefs, each with their own abilities.

  • Chaotic Action: Adapt to random modifiers like fog, broken equipment, demanding guests, and more.

  • Building System: Buy and place furniture to customize your kitchen and increase efficiency.

  • Dynamic Modifiers: Each day brings new twists that force you to rethink your strategy.

  • Meta-Progression: Unlock new furnitures and upgrades that carry over between runs.

  • Strategic Pressure: Balance speed, accuracy, and customer happiness under ever-growing tension.

    Can you keep the kitchen running, or will your diner go down in flames?
